### Problem

The headless update of `main` to repo-canon `v0.29.0` with CLI `11.0.1` stopped with outcome `answers-required`: it needs answers or decisions that only an agent or a person can give.

### Desired outcome

The default branch's selection reaches CLI `11.0.1` and repo-canon `v0.29.0`. To have the action try this release again, such as after changing its agent command, close this issue and run its workflow again. Otherwise, in a clean checkout of `main`, run `npx --yes @lutzseverino/repo-standards@11.0.1 adopt --json`, follow what it prints, and open the adoption pull request. This issue closes once the update lands on `main`, or a newer release replaces it.

### Additional context

The CLI pin stays at `11.0.1`. The repo-canon standards pin moves from `v0.27.0` to `v0.29.0`, a new minor version of a 0.x release, which SemVer allows to break.

Adopter action: Contextual update: 10 declarations differ from the retained inputs. It defers remote setup, which the next local `adopt` applies once its probe is ready: `github-repository-configuration/canonical-labels`, `github-repository-configuration/pull-request-integration`.
